title: Add Google Search Console site verification meta tag site-wide

requirements.text: Add the provided Google Search Console verification meta tag to the global HTML <head> so it is present site-wide on every route.

quotes:
Add the following Google Search Console verification meta tag to the <head> section of my website and apply it site-wide:

<meta name="google-site-verification" content="hym4U2k_e6Y32exhxiM5yIhLCPh_rYLDWpY5B2Mr9wQ" />

acceptanceCriteria: The rendered document <head> includes exactly: <meta name="google-site-verification" content="hym4U2k_e6Y32exhxiM5yIhLCPh_rYLDWpY5B2Mr9wQ" />
The meta tag is present for all pages/routes (site-wide), not only a single page component
No other <head> metadata is removed or altered unintentionally (existing title/viewport/charset remain intact)

requirements.text: Do not change any design, styling, layout, routing, or page content as part of this update (meta tag addition only).

quotes: Do not change any design or layout.

acceptanceCriteria: No visual/UI/layout changes are introduced across the site aside from the added head meta tag

requirements.text: Publish the updated build after adding the meta tag.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production build is deployed that includes the verification meta tag in the global <head>

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Add only the Google Search Console verification meta tag; do not modify design or layout
nonGoals: Adding additional SEO tags (Open Graph, Twitter cards, structured data) beyond the requested verification meta tag
Changing page titles/descriptions or any on-page content
Implementing Google Analytics, Tag Manager, or any other third-party integrations
